prs.cluster_pick_reason: Both patch the identical validation bug at the same call site, but #1996 implements a proper media-type matcher (acceptsMediaType) that correctly handles q-value exclusion (q=0), type/subtype wildcards, case-insensitivity, and parameter/whitespace variations per RFC 7231. #2046 uses plain .includes('application/json') substring checks, which is more fragile - it can misfire on Accept headers containing the substring inside a different media type (e.g. application/json-patch+json) or on entries disabled via q=0, and it does not support wildcard Accept values. #1996's helper is also an independently reusable/testable function rather than inline logic in the handler.
